note: Declared legal standing transitions for a soveraeign-ticket/v1 instance. Standing changes land in the owning governing documents; this table states which transition a coordination surface may accept, from whom, and on what evidence. It grants no authority and settles nothing.

refusal_codes.ACTOR_KIND_REFUSED: The requesting actor_kind may not perform this transition.
refusal_codes.FINDING_NOT_REPRODUCED: A Red finding was not reproduced under observation independent of the Red operator.
refusal_codes.FINDING_UNRESOLVED: A Red finding is still open, so the engagement has not converged.
refusal_codes.FINDING_WITHOUT_FIXTURE: A confirmed Red finding has no permanent defeating fixture in the conformance corpus.
refusal_codes.MISSING_EVIDENCE: A required evidence key is absent or empty. For WITNESSED -> RATIFIED this includes the acceptance packet: an owner is asked to accept a presented result, never a bare question.
refusal_codes.OWNER_JUDGEMENT_REQUIRED: The transition is reserved to a seat that settles JUDGEMENT and was requested from a seat that does not.
refusal_codes.OWNER_RATIFICATION_REQUIRED: Ratification is an owner seat accepting a presented result. It is not reachable by accumulating machine evidence, and it is not requestable in advance as permission to build.
refusal_codes.PURPLE_NOT_SETTLED: The verification dyad has not combined; no settled Red engagement receipt is present.
refusal_codes.SELF_WITNESS_REFUSED: The witness actor is the same actor that built the artifact.
refusal_codes.SKIPPED_STANDING: The requested pair skips a declared intermediate standing.
refusal_codes.UNKNOWN_TRANSITION: The requested from/to pair is not declared in this table.
refusal_codes.EXTERNAL_EFFECT_UNAUTHORIZED: The request declares EXTERNAL_WORLD and names no authorized scope.
refusal_codes.EXTERNAL_EFFECT_OUT_OF_SCOPE: The named scope does not carry the requested verb or target.
refusal_codes.EXTERNAL_EFFECT_VERB_REFUSED: The verb is refused by name in the authorization contract.
refusal_codes.EXTERNAL_EFFECT_WITHOUT_RECEIPT: The request names no receipt, so the attempt would leave no record.

transitions.description: A drafted ticket states its obligation, its priors, and the closure contract that would defeat it.
The owned boundary is named in the repository before any implementation begins.
A charter and a machine-checkable contract exist for the declared boundary.
Blue lane only. A passing self-test establishes BUILT evidence and nothing further.
An independent witness observed the artifact and the verification dyad combined to PURPLE.

An owner seat accepts a presented result. The packet under acceptance/ carries the claim, the demo, the evidence, and what would defeat it; the owner action is recorded against it (contracts/acceptance-policy.json).
A defeating observation demotes standing and preserves the original record.

owner_seats_note: Owner is a seat, not a person (decisions/0020). owner_actor_ids is the projection of the actors currently occupying seats that settle JUDGEMENT; today that is the root seat's occupant. Read the registry, not this list, when the question is who owns whom.
external_effect_note: EXTERNAL_WORLD was once refused by class, which kept irreversible acts behind an owner and ordinary coordination behind one too. The class refusal is gone. An external effect is refused unless the request names a scope contracts/external-effect-authorization.json carries, a verb that scope admits, and the receipt the attempt will leave. Every verb in refused_verbs stays refused whatever scope is claimed.
